gram.t: 碗 / 份 / 杯 — ordering measures
gram.d: Food orders live on measure words: 一碗湯 a bowl of soup, 一份雞排 one order of chicken, 一杯茶 a cup of tea. Point and say 一份 and any stall understands you.

gram.d: Verb + 起來 = 'when you [verb] it': 聞起來臭 smells stinky, 吃起來香 tastes great, 看起來很貴 looks expensive. The sensory-judgment machine.

gram.d: 算 in bargaining = to reckon the price for you: 算你五百 — I'll make it 500 for you. Your line: 算我便宜一點啦！ The 啦 keeps it friendly, not pushy.

gram.d: The gift-presenting formula: 'a small token of our regard.' The 一點 deliberately shrinks the gift — humility is the etiquette. Receiver protests 你太客氣了, you insist gently, everyone wins.

gram.d: Condition + 才能 = only by (doing X) can (Y happen): 保持特色，才能吸引旅客 — only by keeping their character can they keep attracting visitors. The news-editorial hinge word.

dict.en: Want to add an egg?

dict.py: Yèshì rén hǎo duō o!
dict.en: The night market is so crowded!

pass.zh: 欸，今天晚上我們去夜市吃晚餐吧！七點在夜市門口見。我想喝魚湯，你想吃什麼？

qs.q: What's the plan tonight?
Where do they meet at seven?

dict.py: Lǎobǎn, yí fèn jīpái, yào là.
dict.en: Boss, one chicken cutlet — spicy.

dict.zh: 臭豆腐聞起來臭，吃起來香！
dict.py: Chòudòufu wén qǐlái chòu, chī qǐlái xiāng!
dict.en: Stinky tofu smells stinky but tastes amazing!

dict.py: Xiǎochī yí fèn dàgài wǔshí kuài.
dict.en: Snacks run about fifty a serving.

dict.py: Nǐ xiān zhǎo wèizi, wǒ qù mǎi.
dict.en: You grab seats — I'll go buy.

pass.zh: 這家雞排是夜市最有名的攤位，每天都要排三十分鐘。老闆人很好，常常多送學生一塊小的。趁熱吃最好吃！

dict.py: Wǒ zhǐyǒu xiànjīn, kěyǐ ma?
dict.en: I've only got cash — okay?

pass.zh: 那件外套本來一件八百，我跟老闆娘殺價，說要兩件一起買。最後她算我一千二，還送我一雙襪子。夜市買衣服，會殺價真的差很多！

scenarios.intro: You're both starving at the entrance. Decide what to eat, split up to buy, and rendezvous at the seats — the sacred night-market protocol.

them.zh: 哇，人好多！你想吃什麼？
them.py: Wā, rén hǎo duō! Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme?
them.en: Wow, packed! What do you want to eat?

turns.task: Say you want a bowl of fish soup — and meat too!

ans.zh: 我想喝一碗魚湯，也想吃肉！
ans.py: Wǒ xiǎng hē yì wǎn yú tāng, yě xiǎng chī ròu!
ans.en: A bowl of fish soup — and meat too!

them.zh: 好啊！那邊的魚湯很有名喔。
them.py: Hǎo a! Nàbiān de yú tāng hěn yǒumíng o.
them.en: Nice! The fish soup over there is famous.

turns.task: Ask her what she wants to eat.

ans.zh: 妳呢？妳想吃什麼？
ans.py: Nǐ ne? Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme?
ans.en: And you? What do you want?

them.zh: 我要吃蛋餅，再喝一杯紅茶。
them.py: Wǒ yào chī dànbǐng, zài hē yì bēi hóngchá.
them.en: An egg pancake, and a black tea.

turns.task: Suggest: you go buy, she finds seats — okay?

ans.zh: 我去買，妳先找位子，好不好？
ans.py: Wǒ qù mǎi, nǐ xiān zhǎo wèizi, hǎo bù hǎo?
ans.en: I'll buy — you grab seats, yeah?

them.zh: 好！我坐在那個大樹旁邊等你。
them.py: Hǎo! Wǒ zuò zài nàge dà shù pángbiān děng nǐ.
them.en: Deal! I'll be waiting by the big tree.

turns.task: Got it — by the tree; you'll be back in ten minutes.

ans.zh: 好，大樹旁邊。我十分鐘就回來！
ans.py: Hǎo, dà shù pángbiān. Wǒ shí fēnzhōng jiù huílái!
ans.en: By the tree — back in ten!

them.zh: 慢慢來！錢帶了嗎？
them.py: Mànmàn lái! Qián dài le ma?
them.en: No rush! Got money on you?

turns.task: Yes — you brought cash. See you soon!

ans.zh: 帶了，我有現金。等一下見！
ans.py: Dài le, wǒ yǒu xiànjīn. Děng yíxià jiàn!
ans.en: Yep, got cash. See you in a bit!

scenarios.intro: The famous stall, the legendary queue, your turn at the front. Order like a regular: spice level, cut or whole, grab your number.

them.zh: 下一位！要什麼？
them.py: Xià yí wèi! Yào shénme?
them.en: Next! What'll it be?

turns.task: One chicken cutlet, please — a little spicy.

ans.zh: 老闆，一份雞排，要一點辣。
ans.py: Lǎobǎn, yí fèn jīpái, yào yìdiǎn là.
ans.en: One chicken cutlet, boss — a little spicy.

them.zh: 好！要不要切？
them.py: Hǎo! Yào bú yào qiē?
them.en: Sure! Want it cut up?

turns.task: Yes, cut it please — easier to eat.

ans.zh: 要切，謝謝，比較好吃。
ans.py: Yào qiē, xièxie, bǐjiào hǎo chī.
ans.en: Cut it please — easier to eat.

them.zh: 好，七十塊。給你號碼牌，等叫號喔。
them.py: Hǎo, qīshí kuài. Gěi nǐ hàomǎpái, děng jiàohào o.
them.en: Seventy. Here's your number — wait for the call.

turns.task: Hand over the money and ask about how many minutes.

ans.zh: 給你。請問大概要等幾分鐘？
ans.py: Gěi nǐ. Qǐngwèn dàgài yào děng jǐ fēnzhōng?
ans.en: Here you go. About how many minutes?

them.zh: 大概十分鐘，剛炸的比較好吃啦！
them.py: Dàgài shí fēnzhōng, gāng zhá de bǐjiào hǎochī la!
them.en: About ten — fresh from the fryer is worth it!

turns.task: No problem — you'll wait; fresh and hot is best.

ans.zh: 沒問題，我等。熱的最好吃！
ans.py: Méi wèntí, wǒ děng. Rè de zuì hǎochī!
ans.en: No problem, I'll wait — hot is best!

them.zh: 三十八號！你的雞排好囉！
them.py: Sānshíbā hào! Nǐ de jīpái hǎo luō!
them.en: Number 38! Your cutlet's up!

turns.task: That's you — thank the boss, say it smells amazing (好香).

ans.zh: 是我！謝謝老闆，好香喔！
ans.py: Shì wǒ! Xièxie lǎobǎn, hǎo xiāng o!
ans.en: That's me! Thanks boss — smells incredible!

scenarios.intro: A jacket catches your eye at a clothing stall. Try it on, check the size, then deploy the two-for-one gambit. Bargaining is a friendly sport here — play it with a smile.

them.zh: 帥哥，隨便看喔！這件很適合你！
them.py: Shuàigē, suíbiàn kàn o! Zhè jiàn hěn shìhé nǐ!
them.en: Hey handsome, browse away! This one would suit you!

turns.task: Ask if you can try it on.

ans.zh: 老闆娘，這件可以試穿嗎？
ans.py: Lǎobǎnniáng, zhè jiàn kěyǐ shìchuān ma?
ans.en: Can I try this one on?

them.zh: 可以啊！鏡子在旁邊。
them.py: Kěyǐ a! Jìngzi zài pángbiān.
them.en: Of course! Mirror's right there.

turns.task: It fits — but ask if there's a slightly bigger size, just to check.

ans.zh: 還不錯。請問有沒有大一點的尺寸？
ans.py: Hái búcuò. Qǐngwèn yǒu méiyǒu dà yìdiǎn de chǐcùn?
ans.en: Not bad. Do you have one size bigger, just in case?

them.zh: 這件就是最合的啦！一件八百，質感很好喔。
them.py: Zhè jiàn jiùshì zuì hé de la! Yí jiàn bābǎi, zhígǎn hěn hǎo o.
them.en: This IS the right fit! 800 each — great quality.

turns.task: Deploy the move: if you buy two together, make it cheaper!

ans.zh: 老闆娘，兩件一起買，算我便宜一點啦！
ans.py: Lǎobǎnniáng, liǎng jiàn yìqǐ mǎi, suàn wǒ piányí yìdiǎn la!
ans.en: Boss lady — two together, cut me a deal!

them.zh: 你很會買喔……好啦，兩件算你一千二。
them.py: Nǐ hěn huì mǎi o...... hǎo la, liǎng jiàn suàn nǐ yìqiān èr.
them.en: You know how to shop… fine, 1,200 for two.

turns.task: Deal — you'll pay cash; ask for a bag too.

ans.zh: 成交！我付現金。麻煩給我一個袋子。
ans.py: Chéngjiāo! Wǒ fù xiànjīn. Máfán gěi wǒ yíge dàizi.
ans.en: Deal! Cash. And a bag, please.

them.zh: 好！送你一雙襪子，下次再來喔！
them.py: Hǎo! Sòng nǐ yì shuāng wàzi, xiàcì zài lái o!
them.en: Done! Free socks for you — come again!

turns.task: Thank her — she's the best; you'll definitely be back.

ans.zh: 謝謝老闆娘，妳最好了！我一定再來！
ans.py: Xièxie lǎobǎnniáng, nǐ zuì hǎo le! Wǒ yídìng zài lái!
ans.en: Thanks, you're the best! I'll definitely be back!

scenarios.who: 禮盒店店員 Gift Shop Clerk
scenarios.intro: Wednesday's visit needs a proper 伴手禮. Explain the occasion, take the recommendation, get the packaging right — and rehearse the presentation line.

them.zh: 歡迎光臨！想找什麼樣的禮盒呢？
them.py: Huānyíng guānglín! Xiǎng zhǎo shénme yàng de lǐhé ne?
them.en: Welcome! What kind of gift box are you looking for?

turns.task: Explain: Wednesday you're visiting a client company in Kaohsiung — you need a visiting gift.

ans.zh: 你好，我星期三要去高雄拜訪客戶，想買伴手禮。
ans.py: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ xīngqí sān yào qù Gāoxióng bàifǎng kèhù, xiǎng mǎi bànshǒulǐ.
ans.en: Hi — I'm visiting a client in Kaohsiung Wednesday and need a gift.

them.zh: 商務拜訪的話，鳳梨酥禮盒最安全，大家都喜歡。
them.py: Shāngwù bàifǎng dehuà, fènglísū lǐhé zuì ānquán, dàjiā dōu xǐhuān.
them.en: For business visits, pineapple cake boxes are the safe bet — everyone loves them.

turns.task: Take two boxes — and ask for nicer packaging.

ans.zh: 好，那我要兩盒。包裝可以好看一點嗎？
ans.py: Hǎo, nà wǒ yào liǎng hé. Bāozhuāng kěyǐ hǎokàn yìdiǎn ma?
ans.en: Two boxes then — could the packaging be a bit nicer?

them.zh: 沒問題，幫您用禮袋，再加緞帶。要寫卡片嗎？
them.py: Méi wèntí, bāng nín yòng lǐdài, zài jiā duàndài. Yào xiě kǎpiàn ma?
them.en: Sure — gift bag and ribbon. Would you like a card?

turns.task: No card needed — you'll present it in person; it's about the thought (心意).

ans.zh: 不用卡片，我會當面送，重要的是心意。
ans.py: Búyòng kǎpiàn, wǒ huì dāngmiàn sòng, zhòngyào de shì xīnyì.
ans.en: No card — I'll present it in person. It's the thought that counts.

them.zh: 懂行喔！送禮的時候可以說「一點小心意，請笑納」。
them.py: Dǒngháng o! Sònglǐ de shíhòu kěyǐ shuō 'yìdiǎn xiǎo xīnyì, qǐng xiàonà'.
them.en: You know the culture! When presenting, you can say 'a small token — please accept it.'

turns.task: Practice the fuller line back: this is our small token, please accept it.

ans.zh: 這是我們的一點小心意，請笑納。
ans.py: Zhè shì wǒmen de yìdiǎn xiǎo xīnyì, qǐng xiàonà.
ans.en: This is a small token of our appreciation — please accept it.

them.zh: 完美！一共九百六，祝您星期三順利！
them.py: Wánměi! Yígòng jiǔbǎi liù, zhù nín xīngqí sān shùnlì!
them.en: Perfect! 960 total — good luck Wednesday!

turns.task: Thank them — hopefully the contract gets signed!

ans.zh: 謝謝你！希望星期三可以順利簽約！
ans.py: Xièxie nǐ! Xīwàng xīngqí sān kěyǐ shùnlì qiānyuē!
ans.en: Thanks! Here's hoping we sign the contract Wednesday!

scenarios.intro: Tonight's OPI drill: argue what makes night markets matter — economically and culturally — concede the criticism, and land a policy view. Full paragraphs.

them.zh: 很多外國朋友一來台灣就想逛夜市。你覺得夜市的魅力是什麼？
them.py: Hěnduō wàiguó péngyǒu yì lái Táiwān jiù xiǎng guàng yèshì. Nǐ juéde yèshì de mèilì shì shénme?
them.en: Foreign visitors head straight for the night markets. What's the appeal, in your view?

turns.task: Three things: coin-priced food, distinctive local character, and the human warmth (人情味).

ans.zh: 我認為有三點：銅板美食、在地特色，還有台灣的人情味。
ans.py: Wǒ rènwéi yǒu sān diǎn: tóngbǎn měishí, zàidì tèsè, háiyǒu Táiwān de rénqíngwèi.
ans.en: Three things: coin-priced eats, distinct local character, and Taiwan's human warmth.

them.zh: 從經濟的角度看，夜市重要嗎？
them.py: Cóng jīngjì de jiǎodù kàn, yèshì zhòngyào ma?
them.en: Economically speaking, do night markets matter?

turns.task: Yes — they attract tourists and drive spending; for small vendors it's a huge business opportunity.

ans.zh: 很重要。夜市吸引觀光客、帶動消費，對小攤位來說是很大的商機。
ans.py: Hěn zhòngyào. Yèshì xīyǐn guānguāngkè, dàidòng xiāofèi, duì xiǎo tānwèi láishuō shì hěn dà de shāngjī.
ans.en: Very. They pull in tourists, drive spending, and are a huge opportunity for small vendors.

them.zh: 可是也有人批評夜市環境不夠乾淨，你怎麼回應？
them.py: Kěshì yě yǒu rén pīpíng yèshì huánjìng bú gòu gānjìng, nǐ zěnme huíyìng?
them.en: But critics say the sanitation isn't up to scratch. Your response?

turns.task: Concede it's partly true — then argue improvement shouldn't erase character: cleaner, yes, but keep the soul.

ans.zh: 這個批評有一部分是對的。但是改善環境不應該把特色改掉：要更乾淨，也要保留夜市的靈魂。
ans.py: Zhège pīpíng yǒu yíbùfèn shì duì de. Dànshì gǎishàn huánjìng bù yīnggāi bǎ tèsè gǎi diào: yào gèng gānjìng, yě yào bǎoliú yèshì de línghún.
ans.en: Partly fair. But improvement shouldn't erase the character — cleaner, yes, while keeping the soul.

them.zh: 如果政府想幫忙，你會建議什麼？
them.py: Rúguǒ zhèngfǔ xiǎng bāngmáng, nǐ huì jiànyì shénme?
them.en: If the government wanted to help, what would you suggest?

turns.task: Improve infrastructure — water, power, trash — but let vendors keep their flavor; that way night markets can keep attracting the world.

ans.zh: 政府可以改善水電和垃圾的基礎設施，讓攤位保持自己的味道，這樣夜市才能繼續吸引全世界的旅客。
ans.py: Zhèngfǔ kěyǐ gǎishàn shuǐdiàn hàn lèsè de jīchǔ shèshī, ràng tānwèi bǎochí zìjǐ de wèidào, zhèyàng yèshì cáinéng jìxù xīyǐn quán shìjiè de lǚkè.
ans.en: Fix the infrastructure — water, power, trash — and let vendors keep their flavor. Only then can night markets keep drawing the world.

turns.keys: 基礎設施保持才能吸引

them.zh: 說得太好了！最後，推薦一樣你最愛的夜市美食吧！
them.py: Shuō de tài hǎo le! Zuìhòu, tuījiàn yí yàng nǐ zuì ài de yèshì měishí ba!
them.en: Beautifully put! Lastly — recommend your favorite night market dish!

turns.task: Chicken cutlet, obviously — hot from the fryer, and remind everyone: don't judge stinky tofu by its smell.

ans.zh: 當然是雞排，剛炸的最好吃！還有，請大家不要用鼻子決定臭豆腐！
ans.py: Dāngrán shì jīpái, gāng zhá de zuì hǎochī! Háiyǒu, qǐng dàjiā búyào yòng bízi juédìng chòudòufu!
ans.en: Chicken cutlet, fresh from the fryer! And please — don't judge stinky tofu by its smell!

x: 我不太敢吃生魚。
Wǒ bú tài gǎn chī shēng yú.
I don't quite dare eat raw fish.
vocab.n: 魚湯 fish soup; 年年有餘 — fish means surplus at New Year (魚/餘 pun).

x: 你要吃魚還是吃肉？
Nǐ yào chī yú háishì chī ròu?
Fish or meat?
vocab.n: 牛肉 beef, 豬肉 pork, 雞肉 chicken — the animal goes first.

x: 老闆，加一個蛋！
Lǎobǎn, jiā yíge dàn!
Boss, add an egg!
vocab.n: 加蛋 = add egg, the universal Taiwan food upgrade. 蛋餅 = breakfast egg pancake.

x: 天氣冷，喝一碗熱湯吧。
Tiānqì lěng, hē yì wǎn rè tāng ba.
Cold out — have a bowl of hot soup.
vocab.n: You 喝 (drink) soup in Chinese, never eat it.

x: 台南的小吃全台灣最有名。
Táinán de xiǎochī quán Táiwān zuì yǒumíng.
Tainan's street food is Taiwan's most famous.
vocab.n: Literally 'small eats' — but culturally enormous. 小吃店 = a hole-in-the-wall eatery.

x: 這家的雞排比臉還大！
Zhè jiā de jīpái bǐ liǎn hái dà!
Their cutlet is bigger than your face!
vocab.n: The night market king. Standard questions: 要切嗎？(cut it?) 要辣嗎？(spicy?)

x: 臭豆腐要配泡菜才對味。
Chòudòufu yào pèi pàocài cái duìwèi.
Stinky tofu needs pickled cabbage to be right.
vocab.n: The smell-taste paradox incarnate. Ordering it earns instant local respect.

x: 那個攤位每天都在排隊。
Nàge tānwèi měitiān dōu zài páiduì.
That stall has a queue every single day.
vocab.n: Casual spoken version: 攤子 tānzi. Also trade-show booths — biz crossover word.

x: 在夜市買衣服可以殺價。
Zài yèshì mǎi yīfú kěyǐ shājià.
You can haggle for clothes at the night market.
vocab.n: Literally 'kill the price.' Fine at stalls and markets; never in department stores or 7-11.

x: 可以試穿嗎？
Kěyǐ shìchuān ma?
May I try it on?
vocab.n: 試 + verb = give it a try: 試吃 free food samples (Costco energy), 試用 trial period.

x: 這個尺寸對我來說太小了。
Zhège chǐcùn duì wǒ láishuō tài xiǎo le.
This size is too small for me.
vocab.n: Clothes sizes also use 號: M號, L號. Engineering dimensions? Also 尺寸 — handy crossover.

vocab.e: to reckon, count; to charge (a price)
x: 老闆，算我五百啦！
Lǎobǎn, suàn wǒ wǔbǎi la!
Boss, make it 500 for me!
vocab.n: Swiss-army verb: 算你便宜 charge you less, 算了 forget it, 你說了算 you're the boss.

x: 去拜訪客戶要帶伴手禮。
Qù bàifǎng kèhù yào dài bànshǒulǐ.
Bring a gift when visiting clients.
vocab.n: Very Taiwanese word — the gift that 'accompanies your hand.' Pineapple cakes = the default answer.

x: 禮物的包裝很重要。
Lǐwù de bāozhuāng hěn zhòngyào.
A gift's packaging matters a lot.
vocab.n: Also product packaging in business — same word for the gift bag and the shipping box.

x: 他對人很有禮貌。
Tā duì rén hěn yǒu lǐmào.
He's very polite to people.
vocab.n: 有禮貌/沒禮貌 = well-mannered/rude — the axis Taiwanese social judgment runs on.

vocab.e: kind regard, the thought (behind a gift)
x: 禮輕情意重，重要的是心意。
Lǐ qīng qíngyì zhòng, zhòngyào de shì xīnyì.
The gift is small but the feeling is deep — it's the thought that counts.
vocab.n: 一點心意 = the humble formula for presenting anything. Learn it, deploy it Wednesday.

x: 週末的消費金額明顯增加。
Zhōumò de xiāofèi jīn'é míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
Weekend spending has clearly increased.
vocab.n: News-register: 消費者 consumer, 低消 minimum charge at cafés — spot it on every menu.

x: 觀光帶來龐大的商機。
Guānguāng dàilái pángdà de shāngjī.
Tourism brings enormous business opportunities.
vocab.n: 商業+機會 compressed. Headline favorite: 無限商機 unlimited opportunity.

x: 這個活動吸引了很多年輕人。
Zhège huódòng xīyǐn le hěnduō niánqīngrén.
The event attracted lots of young people.
vocab.n: 吸引力 = appeal/attraction; 吸引外資 attract foreign investment — DLPT staple.

x: 每個夜市都有自己的特色。
Měige yèshì dōu yǒu zìjǐ de tèsè.
Every night market has its own character.
vocab.n: 特色小吃 signature snacks, 特色產業 signature industries — the selling-point word.

x: 阿伯看到我就問：呷飽沒？
Ābó kàndào wǒ jiù wèn: jiá-bá-buē?
The uncle saw me and asked: eaten yet?
slang.n: Hokkien. The classic Taiwanese greeting — food IS care. Answer 呷飽啊 (I've eaten) even if you haven't.

x: 這家雞排一份五十，CP值超高！
Zhè jiā jīpái yí fèn wǔshí, CP zhí chāo gāo!
Fifty for this cutlet — insane value!
slang.n: Taiwan's favorite consumer metric, used for food, phones, hotels, everything. 高CP值 = great deal.

slang.e: coin-priced eats — delicious and dirt cheap
x: 這條街全是銅板美食，一百塊吃到飽。
Zhè tiáo jiē quán shì tóngbǎn měishí, yìbǎi kuài chī dào bǎo.
This whole street is coin food — full for a hundred NT.
slang.n: Taiwan media-coined: meals payable in pocket change. The night market's sacred category.

x: 身為吃貨，夜市就是我的天堂。
Shēnwéi chīhuò, yèshì jiùshì wǒ de tiāntáng.
As a certified foodie, the night market is my paradise.
slang.n: Mainland internet origin, fully naturalized in Taiwan. Self-deprecating badge of honor.

x: 我說減肥不吃雞排……真香。
Wǒ shuō jiǎnféi bù chī jīpái...... zhēn xiāng.
I said no cutlet, I'm on a diet… well, that smells amazing.
slang.n: Mainland meme (from a reality show) for caving after swearing off something. Perfect night-market energy.
